title: Fill the bottle
simplified_paragraphs: 孩子们因为琐事打了起来。妈妈就把一个大玻璃瓶子拿出来，瓶子里装着满满的石头、玻璃碎片和沙子。之后，妈妈让孩子们把瓶子里的东西都倒出来，然后再装进去，先从沙子开始。
每个孩子都试了试，最后都发现没有足够的空间装所有的石头。
妈妈指导孩子们重新装这个瓶子。这次，先从石头开始，最后再装沙子。石头装进去后，沙子就沉积在石头的周围，最后，所有东西都装进瓶子里了。
妈妈说：“如果我们先从小的东西开始，把小东西装进去之后，大的石头就放不进去了。生活也是如此，如果你的生活先被不重要的事挤满了，那你就无法再装进更大、更重要的事了。”
traditional_paragraphs: 孩子們因為瑣事打了起來。媽媽就把一個大玻璃瓶子拿出來，瓶子裡裝著滿滿的石頭、玻璃碎片和沙子。之後，媽媽讓孩子們把瓶子裡的東西都倒出來，然後再裝進去，先從沙子開始。
每個孩子都試了試，最後都發現沒有足夠的空間裝所有的石頭。
媽媽指導孩子們重新裝這個瓶子。這次，先從石頭開始，最後再裝沙子。石頭裝進去後，沙子就沉積在石頭的周圍，最後，所有東西都裝進瓶子裡了。
媽媽說：“如果我們先從小的東西開始，把小東西裝進去之後，大的石頭就放不進去了。生活也是如此，如果你的生活先被不重要的事擠滿了，那你就無法再裝進更大、更重要的事了。”
pinyin_paragraphs: hái zi men yīn wèi suǒ shì dǎ le qǐ lái。 mā ma jiù bǎ yī gè dà bō li píng zi ná chu lai， píng zi lǐ zhuāng zhe mǎn mǎn de shí tou、 bō li suì piàn hé shā zi。 zhī hòu， mā ma ràng hái zi men bǎ píng zi lǐ de dōng xi dōu dào chu lai， rán hòu zài zhuāng jìn qù， xiān cóng shā zi kāi shǐ。
měi gè hái zi dōu shì le shì， zuì hòu dōu fā xiàn méi yǒu zú gòu de kōng jiān zhuāng suǒ yǒu de shí tou。

mā ma zhǐ dǎo hái zi men chóng xīn zhuāng zhè gè píng zi。 zhè cì， xiān cóng shí tou kāi shǐ， zuì hòu zài zhuāng shā zi。 shí tou zhuāng jìn qù hòu， shā zi jiù chén jī zài shí tou de zhōu wéi， zuì hòu， suǒ yǒu dōng xi dōu zhuāng jìn píng zi lǐ le。

mā ma shuō：“ rú guǒ wǒ men xiān cóng xiǎo de dōng xi kāi shǐ， bǎ xiǎo dōng xi zhuāng jìn qù zhī hòu， dà de shí tou jiù fàng bù jìn qù le。 shēng huó yě shì rú cǐ， rú guǒ nǐ de shēng huó xiān bèi bù zhòng yào de shì jǐ mǎn le， nà nǐ jiù wú fǎ zài zhuāng jìn gèng dà、 gèng zhòng yào de shì le。”
english_paragraphs: The children got into fights over trivial matters. Mom took out a large glass bottle filled with rocks, glass fragments and sand. After that, the mother asked the children to pour everything out of the bottle and then put it back in, starting with the sand.
Each child tried it, but each found that there was not enough room for all the rocks.

The mother instructs the children to refill the bottle. This time, start with rocks and finish with sand. Once the stone is in, the sand settles around it, and eventually, everything is in the bottle.

Mom said: "If we start with the small things first, after the small things are put in, the big rocks will not fit in. The same is true in life. If your life is filled with unimportant things first, then you will not be able to put in bigger and more important things."
english_full:
The children got into fights over trivial matters. Mom took out a large glass bottle filled with rocks, glass fragments and sand. After that, the mother asked the children to pour everything out of the bottle and then put it back in, starting with the sand.

Each child tried it, but each found that there was not enough room for all the rocks.

The mother instructs the children to refill the bottle. This time, start with rocks and finish with sand. Once the stone is in, the sand settles around it, and eventually, everything is in the bottle.

Mom said: "If we start with the small things first, after the small things are put in, the big rocks will not fit in. The same is true in life. If your life is filled with unimportant things first, then you will not be able to put in bigger and more important things."
